{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs/task-82b7898c.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Match each framed panel's blank-cell mask to a colored pattern, then fill it."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frame = grid[0][0]
    panel_w = 0
    while panel_w < w and grid[0][panel_w] == frame:
        panel_w += 1
    inner_w = panel_w - 2
    # Full frame-colored rows delimit the stacked panels.
    separators = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(panel_w))]
    out = [row[:panel_w] for row in grid]
    # Extract the shape/color in each right-hand band; the shapes may be permuted
    # relative to the panels on the left.
    patterns = []
    source_x = panel_w + 1
    for top, bottom in zip(separators, separators[1:]):
        rows = [grid[r][source_x:source_x + inner_w] for r in range(top + 1, bottom)]
        colors = {v for row in rows for v in row if v != 0}
        if len(colors) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Each source band must contain one colored shape')
        color = next(iter(colors))
        mask = tuple(tuple(v != 0 for v in row) for row in rows)
        patterns.append((mask, color))
    used = set()
    for top, bottom in zip(separators, separators[1:]):
        target = tuple(tuple(grid[r][c] == 0 for c in range(1, panel_w - 1))
                       for r in range(top + 1, bottom))
        matches = [i for i, (mask, _) in enumerate(patterns) if mask == target and i not in used]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError(f'Expected one matching source shape, got {len(matches)}')
        i = matches[0]
        used.add(i)
        color = patterns[i][1]
        for rr, row_mask in enumerate(target):
            for cc, is_hole in enumerate(row_mask):
                if is_hole:
                    out[top + 1 + rr][1 + cc] = color
    return out
"
}
